# Day 19 character fixtures

These PNGs are deterministic, repository-owned test assets generated by:

```bash
node scripts/generate-day19-fixtures.cjs
```

They intentionally use different dimensions:

- `熊猫 normal.png`: 160×120
- `熊猫 angry.png`: 240×120
- `熊猫 mouth-open.png`: 160×52

The differences drive the >30% character-definition warning without relying
on copyrighted artwork.
